headlines.snippet: A 14-year-old boy was killed and 24 others were injured by an unexploded ordnance during a trip in northern Israel. The victims were students and staff from the ORT Ma'alot junior high school. Three are in serious condition, ten moderate, and the rest minor. The IDF stated it was likely a Hezbollah cluster bomb from the war. It is being investigated whether a student placed the ordnance in their bag, causing the explosion. Dozens of Ministry of Education trips to the north will be rerouted.
